description.value: Westview Fresh Pizza is a neighbourhood pizza spot on the North Shore committed to fresh, locally sourced ingredients and what they describe as authentic Canadian pizza. The business operates primarily as a takeout and online-order operation and has drawn praise for attentive owner-led customer service. Touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver could use it as a convenient food stop, though cyclist-specific facilities are unconfirmed.
